Hi Jenna / Michael 


Great to meet today 

thanks for the time. Per our discovery, I wanted to capture the proposed POC/trial plan, success criteria, owners, and immediate next steps so we have a shared working plan. Please review and flag anything you want changed.

High-level goal:
- Validate Redwood Inference can serve search/rerank and chat features in Stellar's checkout flow within 200ms median per-request latency and with acceptable cost (target: <$0.015 per 1k tokens for the workload profile).

Success criteria (proposed):
1) Latency: median end-to-end request latency <= 200ms for typical session (90%ile <= 350ms).
2) Quality: rerank NDCG uplift >= 10% vs current baseline on your evaluation set.
3) Integration: end-to-end infra integration with your staging environment, including SSO and secure VPC connectivity.
4) Observability: Redwood Console shows token-level cost and per-route latency; we have dashboards and alerts configured.

Proposed timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): sign-off on success criteria + NDA/POC MSA in place.
- Week 1: infra setup (VPC peering / private endpoints), SSO test account, and sample dataset transfer.
- Week 2: model onboarding + smoke tests; initial runs and latency profiling.
- Week 3: evaluation runs & quality analysis; cost profiling.
- Week 4: final review and go/no-go decision.

Ownership:
- Redwood: marissa.cole (AE) owner for timelines/coordination; rishi.malhotra (Solutions Eng) for infra & integration; vivek.kulkarni (Customer Success) for onboarding and success measurement.
- Stellar: Jenna Park (PM) owner for product success criteria; Michael Tan (CTO) owner for infra/network/security; procurement for legal/PO.

Immediate next steps:
- Jenna: confirm success criteria and availability for a 30-min kickoff next Tue.
- Michael: share network contact and any firewall rules required for private endpoints.
- Stellar procurement: send PO or MSA queries; we can provide standard POC MSA.
- Redwood: I am attaching a draft POC plan (redwood-poc-plan-v1.pdf) and our standard security questionnaire (we can fill a copy for you once you share).

Attachments: redwood-poc-plan-v1.pdf

Thanks 
looking forward to getting started.

--Marissa

Thanks Marissa 
I'll take infra/security. Quick update after a first pass: 

- VPC/Networking: we can do VPC peering + private endpoint. I expect the Stellar infra team will need our CIDR ranges and the list of outbound IPs for initial allowlisting. I'll send a short firewall rule checklist (ETA Mon).

- SSO: we support SAML; please have Stellar provide a test IDP metadata URL.

- Security questionnaire: filling infra items now; there are a few items that will require legal & security sign-off (SOC 2 report, KMS/HSM details). I'll flag those and loop in security.

Potential POC risks / current findings:
1) GPU OOM on long-sequence rerank job: during a quick local repro with a copy of their sample batch I hit an out-of-memory when using the unquantized model at their max sequence length. Workaround: use 4-8 token chunking and progressive KV cache reuse to avoid loading full context at once. Long-term: provision a quantized model variant (8-bit) and a 1x A100 as a dedicated instance for the POC.
  - Severity: blocking for full-scale rerank runs (mitigation required before Week 2 evaluation).
  - Owner: rishi_malhotra.
  - Escalation: infra-investigation ticket SUP-1234 created; if not resolved in 48h escalate to infra-leads@redwood.com.

2) Missing SOC 2 evidence: may delay procurement signature.
  - Owner: marissa_cole (coordinate with security).
  - Mitigation: provide SOC 2 Type II summary + redacted controls; offer interim access to SOC artifacts under NDA.

I'll attach a short log snippet and the repro notes.

Attachments: gpu-oom-log-snippet.txt

--Rishi
